data.title: Embedded Software Intern
data.description: Write firmware for warehouse robots in C++ and test it on real hardware with the controls team.
data.requirements: C or C++, basic electronics, curiosity about hardware.

data.title: Product Design Intern
data.description: Shape the patient check-in experience of a telehealth app, from research interviews to Figma prototypes.
data.requirements: A portfolio with two case studies, Figma.

data.title: Data Science Intern
data.description: Build models that forecast solar output for community energy projects using Python and open weather data.

data.title: iOS Engineering Intern
data.description: Ship SwiftUI features for a puzzle game played by two million people and pair with senior engineers every week.
data.requirements: Swift, one app you built yourself.

data.title: Operations Analyst Intern
data.description: Find bottlenecks in cross-border shipping routes and present your fixes to the operations leadership.

data.title: Brand Design Intern
data.description: Design campaigns, motion pieces and social assets for startups launching their first product.
data.requirements: Adobe or Figma, a sharp eye for type.

data.title: Security Engineering Intern
data.description: Help the red team test internal tools, write detection rules and document what you find.

data.title: Content Strategy Intern
data.description: Plan and write lessons for a learning app that teaches coding to high-school students in Latin America.
data.requirements: Strong writing in English and Spanish.

data.title: Lab Automation Intern
data.description: Automate lab experiments with Python scripts that drive liquid-handling robots.

data.title: Backend Engineering Intern
data.description: Build Go services behind a developer platform used by thousands of teams, with real code review from day one.
data.requirements: Any backend language, Git, HTTP basics.
